title: I2C bus with timing

implements.text: Start, address, write, read with ACK or NACK, and stop, one byte costing nine bit times
Transfer time from the bus speed, 100 kHz standard mode up to 1 MHz
NACK, address conflict, a bus with no pull-up held low, and a rise time over the mode limit from the pull-up and capacitance

mocked.text: A bus with no stated pull-up assumes one; the event says so

unsupported.text: Edge shapes: the bus works in transfers, not voltages

knownFailureCases: The default 50 pF load is an assumed figure
